built_from: Built from the official trophy descriptions only: which story chapters and missions, which collectibles and counts, in what order. No step here claims a location or a trick the descriptions do not give.
missable_note: 23 trophies are flagged missable in this guide. A flag means the trophy is tied to one story moment, one mission or one partner window in its official description — earn it the first time that moment comes. It does not mean the trophy is lost forever if you miss it: the game may let you replay missions. Save before the flagged moments and check the Missables page before each story session.

stages.name: Play the story
stages.text: Play the main story in order, from the opening mission Gone Fishing through Chapters 1 to 4 and the final mission. This stage earns the chapter trophies and the named-mission trophies — 12 trophies in all. Do the missable moments as they come: the partner trophies and the VCIA departure belong to this stretch too, so check the Missables page before each story session.

stages.name: Side characters and strangers
stages.text: Finish the five character strands — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone — each ending in one final mission, then work the stranger strands until 8 are complete and hunt Bret's unique animal. Nine trophies. Do this while your partner is still around for the two partner trophies, Hot Together and Retail Therapy.

stages.name: Activities and challenges
stages.text: The long middle: try every activity type once, then work the skill gates — 250 stunts, gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, drone races at all 14 locations, 20 different race wins, 50 challenges — plus the one-offs: fishing against Cal, an arcade game, meditation at all 18 spots, the cocktail on Ocean Beach, bowling at Kolt & Associates, the showroom smash, the 5-enemy Combat Focus, the Rhino, the strange event and the second-try trophy. Nineteen trophies, and the grind trophies here are the ones to start early so they finish themselves.

stages.name: Collectibles and exploration
stages.text: Sweep the map: 3 card sets, WAiNK It at 100 locations, 100 vehicles discovered, all 52 areas of Leonida, all 8 garage properties bought and 10 vehicles registered to the Scooter Bros app. Six trophies. Do this after the story, when the whole map is open and you have the money for the garages.

stages.name: Money, robberies and cleanup
stages.text: The endgame: rob the jewelry store undetected, 5 bank vaults, an armored truck and one illegal operation per gang — 9 gangs — while laundering $250,000 of marked bills and spending $100,000 across the shops. Then the unscheduled departure at VCIA if you have not done it yet, and the last two trophies: 100% completion and the platinum. Nine trophies, and the platinum pops with A Long Road.

title: Roadmap to the platinum
